dct_description_sm: Paraguay administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 4 levels: - Admin 1: 18 Departamento - Admin 2: 263 Distrito - Admin 3: 7994 Barrio/Localidad - Admin 4: 105952 Manzana, partial coverage Dates associated with this dataset: - 09 July 2026: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 29 July 2026: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 29 July 2026: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 01 January 2022: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Dirección General de Estadísticas, Encuestas y Censos (DGEEC), INE: Instituto Nacionel de Estadistica Paraguay
